title: Topic 3.7: The Rich man and Lazarus

pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE RICH MAN AND LAZARUS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.7: The Rich man and Lazarus

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Rich man and Lazarus. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in The Rich man and Lazarus
2. Practise The Rich man and Lazarus at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Rich man and Lazarus

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in The Rich man and Lazarus
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in The Rich man and Lazarus. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise The Rich man and Lazarus at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise The Rich man and Lazarus at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Rich man and Lazarus
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to The Rich man and Lazarus. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Rich man and Lazarus using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Rich man and Lazarus in the examples.
2. Explain The Rich man and Lazarus to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Rich man and Lazarus.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Rich man and Lazarus using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Rich man and Lazarus important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in The Rich man and Lazarus
2. Practise The Rich man and Lazarus at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Rich man and Lazarus

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
